title: CAT 2021 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Percentages
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Identical chocolate pieces are sold in boxes of two sizes, small and large. The large box is sold for twice the price of the small box. If the selling price per gram of chocolate in the large box is 12% less than that in the small box, then the percentage by which the weight of chocolate in the large box exceeds that in the small box is nearest to
questions.explain:
Let $P_S$ and $P_L$ be the prices, and $W_S$ and $W_L$ be the weights for the small and large boxes, respectively.
We know $P_L = 2P_S$.
The price per gram for the small box is $p_S = \frac{P_S}{W_S}$, and for the large box is $p_L = \frac{P_L}{W_L}$.
We're given that $p_L = 0.88p_S$ (12% less).
Substitute the formulas: $\frac{P_L}{W_L} = 0.88 \times \frac{P_S}{W_S}$.
Since $P_L = 2P_S$, we get $\frac{2P_S}{W_L} = 0.88 \frac{P_S}{W_S}$.
$\frac{2}{W_L} = \frac{0.88}{W_S} \implies \frac{W_L}{W_S} = \frac{2}{0.88} = \frac{200}{88} = \frac{25}{11} \approx 2.2727$.
The percentage excess is $\left( \frac{W_L}{W_S} - 1 \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{25}{11} - 1 \right) \times 100 = \frac{14}{11} \times 100 \approx 127.27\%$.
Nearest value is 127.
